title: ITM champion paper leaderboard
vwap_mode: IST session VWAP — use OPTIDX volume when >0; equal-weight assume on zero-volume bars (offline / sparse tape).

champions_catalog.name: EMA×ST (lab winner)
champions_catalog.plain_english: 5m: buy when EMA9 crosses above EMA21 and price > Supertrend(10,3); exit on EMA cross down or close below Supertrend.
champions_catalog.why_remembered: Best aggregate after-cost on 10 ITM PE+CE Aug–Sep sweep (~41% WR).

champions_catalog.name: EMA×ST + VWAP filter
champions_catalog.plain_english: Same as EMA×ST, but only enter when premium is above session VWAP (volume-weighted; equal-weight assume if vol=0).
champions_catalog.why_remembered: Tuesday-ready: live session VWAP should tighten entries vs lab.

champions_catalog.name: SMA10×50 + SL/TP
champions_catalog.plain_english: 5m: SMA10 crosses above SMA50; exit on cross down or 15% SL / 30% TP.
champions_catalog.why_remembered: Runner-up on strike sweep; most contracts positive (12/20).

champions_catalog.name: VWAP + RSI cross (Pine)
champions_catalog.plain_english: 5m: price > session VWAP, RSI≥60, above EMA21, EMA3×WMA21 cross up; exit cross down or RSI<55. SL20%/TP40%.
champions_catalog.why_remembered: Founder Pine path — needs live VWAP; assumed VWAP used in offline lab.

champions_catalog.name: EMA9×21 + VWAP
champions_catalog.plain_english: 5m: EMA9×21 cross with price above session VWAP; exit below VWAP or cross down.
champions_catalog.why_remembered: Simple VWAP-gated trend for live paper comparison.

champions_catalog.name: BB mean-revert
champions_catalog.plain_english: 5m: bounce off lower Bollinger(20,2.5); exit mid-band or RSI≥55.
champions_catalog.why_remembered: High win-rate on single-strike lab; lost across strike sweep — challenger.

champions_catalog.name: Flawless v1 · 10m BB×1.5
champions_catalog.plain_english: 10m Flawless v1: buy close < BB lower(20,1.5) and RSI>42; sell close > BB upper and RSI>70. No SL/TP.
champions_catalog.why_remembered: Top Flawless grid cell on ITM premiums (~79% succ, PE-biased).

champions_catalog.name: Flawless v1 · 5m BB×2.0
champions_catalog.plain_english: 5m Flawless v1: BB(20,2.0) + RSI>42 entry; BB upper + RSI>70 exit. No SL/TP.
champions_catalog.why_remembered: Best 5m Flawless cell after costs on premium watch set.

champions_catalog.name: Flawless v1 · 10m BB×2.0
champions_catalog.plain_english: 10m Flawless v1: BB(20,2.0) + RSI>42 entry; BB upper + RSI>70 exit. No SL/TP.
champions_catalog.why_remembered: Wider-band 10m Flawless companion (high succ %, fewer trades).

champions_catalog.name: Flawless v1 · 1m early RSI exit
champions_catalog.plain_english: 1m Flawless v1: BB(20,1) + RSI>42 entry; exit BB upper + RSI>60 (earlier than Pine 70).
champions_catalog.why_remembered: Only 1m Flawless cell green after costs on watch set.

champions_catalog.name: Flawless v1 · 15m BB17
champions_catalog.plain_english: 15m Flawless v1: BB(17,1) + RSI>42 entry; BB upper + RSI>70 exit. No SL/TP.
champions_catalog.why_remembered: Best 15m Flawless cell (modest +₹); slow TF for paper watch.
